question.text: 'Separately Managed Accounts' (SMAs) are a carve-out from:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per workbook p.47, Separately Managed Accounts (SMAs) are described as a carve-out from the fund structure. The Trap: SMAs are not described in the workbook as carve-outs from broker accounts, mutual-fund SIPs, or pension funds. Note: The "carve-out from the fund structure" wording is taken directly from workbook p.47.
